about_the_game:
🐾 Eternity 🐾


A game shaped by love. A world built by memory.
Nearly 3,000 real player-submitted pets and a handful of player-created additions have found their place in Eternity—a hand-crafted tribute to the companions who walked with us through our darkest nights and brightest days. This is not simply a game. This is a quiet, beautiful world where lost friends are waiting to be remembered… and gently guided home.

🕯️ Welcome to Otherside
Step into Otherside, a dreamlike liminal realm where lost pets drift between time and memory. As the caretaker of this realm, your role is clear:
Find them. Listen to them. Love them. And lead them to peace.

Every animal you encounter was submitted by a real player selected from our previous games. This is our way of showing support for those who have supported us. Each name, each description, each soul. Whether a dog who waited by the door, a cat who curled into your side, or a bird who sang only for you—they are here. And they remember you.

🌸 Key Features
✨ Nearly 3,000 Real Pets Submitted by Players
Every pet is unique, heartfelt, and eternal.

💌 Emotional Exploration Through Otherside
Search mysterious, symbolic environments where each pet hides in memory, waiting to be found.

🎁 Collect Gifts and Build Eternal Realms
Pets leave behind gifts—tokens of joy, grief, or love. These gifts contain essence, which you can use to create entire realms of eternity tailored to each soul.

🐾 Choose Their Eternity
No pet is sent away. You choose where they go. You shape their afterlife. You give them a home.

📖 A Story of Grief, Healing, and Connection
Unlock fragments of lore that slowly reveal the nature of Otherside and your place within it. This is a story about love without conditions—and what comes after goodbye.

🌅 Multiple Endings Based on Your Choices
Your guidance matters. The eternities you create… become your legacy.

💖 A Love That Outlives Time
Eternity is a soft place for hard feelings. A place for those grieving. For those remembering. For those who never got to say goodbye. Or even those who never had a pet—but feel the weight of absence just the same.

Some bonds are unbreakable.
Some names are never meant to fade.

🎇 You Are Part of This
Every player who submitted a pet gave the world a star. Now you walk beneath that sky—finding them one by one, listening, remembering, and giving them rest.

You are not just playing a game. You are giving them a forever-home.

This is Eternity.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 98/XP/Vista/7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium III 800 Mhz
  • Graphics: 1024x768 or better video resolution in High Color mode
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound-compatible sound card

This isn't just a game—it’s a sanctuary of love, memory, and peace. Some bonds never fade. Some names were made to live forever. Welcome to Eternity.
